description: Lingam is a Tamil crime thriller series starring Kathir and Divya Bharathi. The story follows a kabaddi player whose dream of becoming a police officer is destroyed after he is framed for murder. Forced into the criminal underworld, he transforms into a feared gangster seeking survival and revenge.
title: Lingam OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch it Online?

description: Using JWST, astronomers obtained the most detailed spectrum yet of a little red dot and found evidence that these mysterious objects are rapidly growing black holes wrapped in dense gas. The discovery could explain why they appear, shine red, and eventually disappear from the cosmic record.
title: JWST Reveals the True Identity of Mysterious Little Red Dots

description: Samsung has reportedly started rolling out a new One UI 8.5 update for the Galaxy S25 series in South Korea. The release adds several Galaxy AI features that were previously limited to the Galaxy S26 lineup, including tools that prioritise important alerts, summarise notification threads, and generate summaries of PDF and TXT files. The update also includes the June 2026 Android security patch and carries build number S938NKSUACZF1. Samsung has not yet announced when the rollout will expand to other regions.
title: Samsung Galaxy S25 Gets New Galaxy AI Features From Galaxy S26 With New One UI 8.5 Update

description: Honor Magic 9 series is tipped to introduce support for an official stylus accessory. The stylus is tipped to offer a range of AI-powered features. The foldable smartphones from Honor so far offered this feature. The Honor Magic 9 series is likely to go official in October this year with the Magic 9, Magic 9 Pro, and Magic 9 RSR models. They are rumoured to feature 8,000mAh battery units and 200-megapixel primary rear cameras.
title: Honor Magic 9 Series to Launch With Official Stylus Accessory, Tipster Claims

description: WhatsApp is reportedly developing a scheduled messaging feature for iPhone that would work in both individual and group chats. Users may be able to choose a delivery time by holding the send button and schedule messages up to two weeks in advance. The feature is also expected to include a dedicated section for managing pending messages and deleting them before delivery. Scheduled messages in groups would only reach members who were present when the message was created. The functionality remains under development.
title: WhatsApp's Scheduled Messages Feature Leaks Ahead of Release, Might Offer Various Useful Capabilities

description: Oppo is said to launch a wide foldable smartphone dubbed Find N7. A new leak suggests that it will be launched in the first quarter of 2027. It is said to measure 7.6-inch foldable display and a 5.5-inch cover screen. The Oppo Find N7 is likely to ship with the upcoming Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 processor. It is likely to compete with Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Apple's first foldable smartphone.
title: Oppo Find N7 Key Specifications Leaked,  Could Launch in 2027 as a Wide-Screen Foldable Phone

description: Apple is bringing new recovery options with its new iOS 27 version, according to a Reddit user. Spotted in the first developer beta of the iOS 27 update, build 24A55355q, the OS will seemingly allow users to boot up their iPhone in the “Recovery Assistant” option, which is capable of “automatically” identifying software issues and attempting to fix them. Moreover, the iOS 27 update could allow iPhone users to restore their handset to the latest version of iOS available with the Software Update recovery option. The image also shows a Diagnostics Mode, which seemingly allows Apple Support to run tests on the smartphone to identify hardware and software issues.
title: iOS 27 Might Let iPhone Users Boot Up Their Handset in a New macOS-Like Recovery Mode

description: Ubisoft is closing two more of its studios as part of its ongoing restructuring efforts. The company's team in Winnipeg and Belgrade will be shuttered and its studio in Barcelona will be reorganised to focus solely on the Rainbow Six franchise, according to reports. As a result of the latest round of cuts, around 380 employees will be laid off.
title: Ubisoft Shuts Down 2 More Studios, Lays Off Up to 380 Employees in Latest Round of Cost Cuts

description: Lock Upp Season 2 returns with new hosts, tougher challenges, and intense prison drama as contestants battle for survival and victory.
title: Lock Upp Season 2 OTT Release Date: Riteish Deshmukh and Farah Khan Bring More Drama to This Reality Show

description: Hosted by Shilpa Shetty Kundra, Maa Hai Na is an upcoming reality web series that will feature Gen Z stars with their mothers, engaging in a cooking battle.
title: Maa Hai Na OTT Release Date Revealed: When and Where to Watch This Shilpa Shetty Starrer Reality Show?

description: Vivo Y500 4G could be launched soon in select global markets, as the smartphone has appeared on the Google Play Console's list of supported devices with the model numbers V2570, V2584, V2627, V2634, and V2635, which might correspond to different regions. The smartphone is said to be powered by an octa core Spreadtrum UM9360 SoC, which is said to be the Unisoc T7300 chipset. The handset will reportedly feature six efficiency cores, clocked at 2.0GHz, and two performance cores, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.2GHz.
title: Vivo Y500 4G Could Launch Soon, Smartphone Gets Listed on Google Play Console

description: Asus expanded the Zephyrus series in India with the new Zephyrus Duo, alongside ROG Zephyrus G14 and ROG Zephyrus G16 laptops. The Zephyrus Duo features dual touchscreen displays and is powered by an Intel Core Ultra 9 Series 3 processor. The ROG Zephyrus G14 also features an Intel Core Ultra Series 3 chipset, while the larger ROG Zephyrus G16 is available with Intel Core Ultra 9 processor configurations.
title: Asus ROG Zephyrus Duo Launched in India Alongside Zephyrus G14, Zephyrus G16 Models

description: Asus has launched the ProArt PZ14 in India with a detachable 2-in-1 design, a 14-inch 3K OLED touchscreen, and a Snapdragon X2 Elite processor. The laptop features a Qualcomm Hexagon NPU capable of delivering up to 80 TOPS of AI performance, 32GB RAM, and 1TB SSD storage. It also offers Wi-Fi 7 connectivity, dual cameras, stylus support, and a 75Wh battery. The ProArt PZ14 is priced at Rs. 2,69,990 and comes with pre-order offers worth up to Rs. 25,599.
title: Asus ProArt PZ14 Launched in India Alongside Refreshed Asus TUF Gaming A14: Price, Features

description: Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold 8 Wide and Galaxy Z Flip 8 have appeared in the BIS certification database, hinting at an imminent India launch. The listings were spotted alongside a Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra model, which had surfaced in an earlier BIS filing. While the certifications do not reveal specifications, they suggest Samsung is preparing its next foldable lineup for the Indian market. The phones are expected to debut at a Galaxy Unpacked event rumoured to take place on July 22.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Wide, Z Flip 8 Reportedly Visit BIS Database; India Launch Seems Imminent

description: OnePlus N6 will be launched in India soon, the smartphone maker revealed on Thursday. The new smartphone will arrive as the first model in the tech firm’s new OnePlus N series. A dedicated microsite for the launch of the smartphone is now live on Amazon, confirming its availability via the e-commerce platform, while also teasing its design and colour options. The handset will be offered in at least black and green colourways. It is shown to feature a flat rear panel and a flat frame. A power button and volume controls will be placed on the right side of the OnePlus N6.
title: OnePlus N6 India Launch Teased Along With Colour Options and Design

description: Vi has announced a series of network expansion initiatives across India. The company has released 5G in Ludhiana, Jalandhar, and Patiala. It will also extend the 5G coverage to Amritsar by this month. Vi has also launched its 5G services in Coimbatore, Tiruppur, and Vellore. Further, Vi has restored mobile connectivity on Mumbai Metro's Aqua Line 3, spanning across the 16 stations from Aarey JVLR to Acharya Atre Chowk.
title: Vi 5G Network Expands to More Cities; Airtel and Vi Restore Mobile Network Services on Mumbai Metro Aqua Line 3

description: Microsoft is reportedly planning a significant round of layoffs at Xbox as the division's new leadership implements a business reset. The layoffs will be implemented next month, a Bloomberg report said. Xbox chief Asha Sharma said in a memo that the company needed to face hard truths and overhaul its business across content, services, and hardware.
title: Xbox Reportedly Planning Layoffs Next Month as CEO Asha Sharma Details Need to 'Reset' Business

description: The Pova 8 is Tecno’s brand-new offering in the mid-range. It has a new design, a massive high-capacity battery, but everything else remains similar to the previous model. Priced a lot higher and marketed as a mid-range smartphone, can it attract buyers with its new Alive Matrix Display? Read on to find out.
title: Pova 8 Review: Bold Design, Big Ambitions

description: FIFA World Cup 2026’s opening match is scheduled to start on June 12 at 12:30 am IST, during which Mexico and South Africa will face each other in the Mexico City Stadium. You can watch the match via OTT and TV channels. You can watch all the FIFA World Cup 2026 matches via the Zee5 app on smartphones, tablets, and smart TVs. Meanwhile, you can visit the Zee5 website to watch the matches on your desktops and laptops. Zee will also broadcast the FIFA World Cup 2026 matches via its newly launched Unite8 Sports 1, Unite8 Sports 1 HD, Unite8 Sports 2, or Unite8 Sports 2 HD TV channels.
title: FIFA World Cup 2026: How to Watch the World Cup Live on OTT and TV Channels
Five Things You Need to Know About the Xiaomi FX Mini LED With Fire TV Built-in

description: Price details and key specifications of the Xiaomi Mix Fold 5 have leaked on the Web. The Xiaomi Mix Fold 5 is tipped to come with a 200-megapixel camera. It could come with a 6,000mAh battery with support for wireless charging. The new model will succeed the Mix Fold 4, which was unveiled in 2024.
title: Xiaomi Mix Fold 5 Tipped to Launch With 200-Megapixel Rear Camera and a Higher Price Tag

description: Google has responded after a German court ruled that the company can be held responsible for inaccurate information generated by AI Overviews. The case involved AI-generated summaries that allegedly linked two publishers to scams and questionable business practices. Google said it is reviewing the decision and stressed that the ruling is not final. The court reportedly found that AI Overviews create original summaries rather than traditional search results, a finding that could have broader implications for AI-powered search and answer platforms.
title: German Court Says Google Can Be Held Accountable for AI Overviews Errors, Company Responds

description: Marshall has introduced the Stockwell III portable Bluetooth speaker, seven years after the previous generation. The speaker features a replaceable battery rated for over 40 hours of playback, Bluetooth 5.3 with Auracast support, and an IP55-rated design. It uses a three-driver stereo setup with 360-degree audio and offers fast charging, with 20 minutes of charging claimed to provide up to eight hours of use. The Stockwell III is listed in India at Rs. 26,999, while availability details for the market remain unconfirmed.
title: Marshall Stockwell III Launched 7 Years After Second-Gen Model With Upgraded Replaceable Battery: Price, Features

description: Vivo X500 will be launched in China this year with an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 9500 series chipset, a tipster claims. This is contrary to earlier leaks, which suggested that the smartphone maker will equip the handset with the unreleased MediaTek Dimensity 9600 SoC. The chip is said to be an upgraded version of last year’s flagship Dimensity 9500 chip, internally codenamed DX5. The currently Vivo X300 and Vivo X300 Pro are powered by the same 3nm octa core Dimensity 9500 SoC. However, reports suggest that the company might equip this year’s Vivo X500 series phones with different chipsets.
title: Vivo X500 Tipped to Launch This Year With an 'Upgraded' Dimensity 9500 Series Chip, Telephoto Camera

description: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ is now on sale in India, the smartphone maker announced on Thursday. The new handset is offered in three Pantone-curated colour options, dubbed Chicory Coffee, Stormy Sea, and Zinfandel. It is available for purchase in the country via Flipkart and the Motorola India online store in a single 12GB + 256GB RAM and storage configuration. The Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ is powered by an octa core MediaTek Dimensity 8500 Extreme chipset, which is claimed to deliver a peak clock speed of 3.4GHz. It sports a 6.8-inch 1.5K Extreme AMOLED display, with 450 ppi pixel density, up to 144Hz of refresh rate, and up to 5,200 nits peak brightness.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ With 50-Megapixel Telephoto Camera Goes on Sale in India: Price, Offers

description: Pova 8 has been launched in India with a 6.76-inch display with a 144Hz refresh rate and an 8,000mAh battery. It runs on a MediaTek Dimensity 7100 processor paired with a Mali-G610 MC2 GPU. It comes in 6GB and 8GB LPDDR5X RAM options. It has a 50-megapixel Sony LYTIA 600 primary rear camera and a 13-megapixel selfie shooter. The Pova 8 is available in three colour options and will go on sale through Flipkart.
title: Pova 8 Launched in India With Dimensity 7100, 8,000mAh Battery and Alive Matrix Display: Price, Specifications

description: Insta360 has launched the Luna Ultra, a Leica co-developed gimbal camera featuring a 1-inch main sensor, a dedicated telephoto camera, and three-axis stabilisation. The device supports video recording at up to 8K resolution, Dolby Vision, 10-bit I-Log, and up to 12x zoom. It also includes a detachable 2-inch OLED touchscreen, a triple-chip architecture with a Qualcomm 4nm AI processor, and up to 240 minutes of battery life. The camera starts at $769.99 (roughly Rs. 73,700) and is available in two colour options.
title: Insta360 Luna Ultra Unveiled With Leica-Tuned Cameras, 2-Inch Detachable OLED Screen: Price, Features

description: PS Plus Game Catalogue titles for June have been revealed. This month, the game subscription service is adding Final Fantasy XVI, Kingdom Come: Deliverance, Sonic X Shadow Generations, Life is Strange: Double Exposure, and more. All games will be playable from June 16 in most regions.
title: PS Plus Game Catalogue Titles for June Announced: Final Fantasy XVI, Kingdom Come: Deliverance and More

description: Oppo K15 has been spotted on the Telecommunication Equipment Certification Centre (TENAA) database in China with the model number PYD110, hinting at an imminent launch in the country. Along with this, the listing also reveals key specifications and features of the rumoured smartphone. The handset is expected to sport a 6.59-inch (1,256 × 2,760 pixels) AMOLED display, offering a colour depth of 1.07 billion. Moreover, the Oppo K15 could be backed by a 7,755mAh battery, which could be marketed as an 8,000mAh cell.
title: Oppo K15 Listing on Certification Website Reveals Key Specifications and Features Ahead of Anticipated Launch

description: Wear OS 7 is likely to arrive soon on Pixel Watch. Verizon appears to have prematurely revealed that the update is preparing to roll out to three Pixel Watch models. Google announced Wear OS 7 at its I/O 2026 with several design changes inspired by Android 17. Wear OS 7 comes with power optimisations and new system capabilities. The Live Updates and improved media controls are the key highlights of the update.
title: Google's Wear OS 7 Update for Three Pixel Watch Models Will Roll Out Soon , Telco's Website Shows
